description: This file contains functions and types for rendering diff documents, including patch and before/after diffs, with HTML generation and fallback mechanisms, referencing external diff processing modules.

methods.name: escapeCssString
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and double quotes in a string for CSS usage.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: escapeJsonScript
methods.description: Converts a value to JSON string and escapes '<' characters.

methods.name: buildDiffTitle
methods.description: Generates a title for the diff based on input properties.

methods.name: resolveBeforeAfterFileName
methods.description: Determines filename for before/after diffs based on input and language.

methods.name: buildDiffOptions
methods.description: Creates diff viewer options with CSS styling based on presentation settings.

methods.name: buildImageRenderOptions
methods.description: Adjusts render options for image mode, increasing font size.

methods.name: shouldRenderViewer
methods.description: Checks if viewer should be rendered based on target.

methods.name: shouldRenderImage
methods.description: Checks if image should be rendered based on target.

methods.name: buildRenderVariants
methods.description: Builds viewer and image options based on target and input options.

methods.name: renderDiffCard
methods.description: Wraps diff payload HTML into a styled section with JSON payload.

methods.name: buildHtmlDocument
methods.description: Generates full HTML document string with styles and diff content.

methods.name: buildRenderedSection
methods.description: Creates a section with viewer and/or image HTML content.

methods.name: buildRenderedBodies
methods.description: Combines multiple sections into full HTML bodies for viewer and image.

methods.name: renderBeforeAfterDiff
methods.description: Renders a before/after diff into HTML, handling language and fallback.

methods.name: renderPatchDiff
methods.description: Renders patch diffs into HTML, with size checks and fallback.

methods.name: renderDiffDocument
methods.description: Main exported function to generate full diff document HTML or image HTML.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToClientHydration
methods.description: Determines if fallback to client hydration is needed based on error.

methods.name: preloadFileDiffWithFallback
methods.description: Preloads file diff with fallback on specific errors.

methods.name: preloadMultiFileDiffWithFallback
methods.description: Preloads multiple file diffs with fallback on specific errors.
